# MusicXML 3.1 schema fixtures

These schemas are from the [W3C MusicXML 3.1 release](https://github.com/w3c/musicxml/tree/v3.1/schema):
[musicxml.xsd](https://github.com/w3c/musicxml/blob/v3.1/schema/musicxml.xsd),
[xlink.xsd](https://github.com/w3c/musicxml/blob/v3.1/schema/xlink.xsd), and
[xml.xsd](https://github.com/w3c/musicxml/blob/v3.1/schema/xml.xsd).

Copyright © 2004–2017 the Contributors to the MusicXML Specification,
published by the W3C Music Notation Community Group under the
[W3C Community Final Specification Agreement](https://www.w3.org/community/about/agreements/final/).
Original notices and the XML namespace documentation are retained in the files.

The two imports in `musicxml.xsd` use local paths so validation works without a network.
Line endings and trailing whitespace have been normalized. The schema definitions are unchanged.
